title: Potion Shop
description: Potion Shop adds a structured system for obtaining potions by replacing randomness with clear pricing and player choice, allowing better planning, resource management, and more consistent progression.
body:
🧪 Potion Shop

Why rely on luck when you can build a system?
Random drops are fine early game. After that — they just waste your time.

Potion Shop gives you structured, controlled access to potions — without killing balance.

What does it add?
– Tier-based potion pricing
– Full control over economy
– Reduced RNG dependency

❓ Is this overpowered?
→ Only if you ignore resource balance.

❓ What’s the real benefit?
→ Consistency. You stop grinding blindly and start making decisions.

🛒 Commands:

/shop tier basic 5
→ Set all basic potions to cost 5 iron

/shop tier combat 3
→ Combat potions cost 3 gold

/shop tier rare 1
→ Rare potions cost 1 diamond

/shop price strength 5
→ Override price for a specific potion
